name: Atori
source:
Atori works as a telephone operator on Haikyo island. She suffered from worsening eyesight and illness after her lover left the island.
Decent at taking care of people. As Souichirou and Kyouko's babysitter, she used to play with them a lot since their childhood. Atori is also a very patient person, however, she is willing to take action, shall the line of endurance be crossed.
She also loves red flowers.
